title: The resolvent-dressed Wick vacuum column has sharp exponent threshold five halves

resolvent_column.definition: With A=H_0+1 and W_N=V_N Omega, define G_(r,N)Omega=A^(-r)W_N
resolvent_column.sharp_threshold: K1440 implies norm convergence for every r>5/2 and unboundedness for every r<=5/2; at r=5/2 disjoint dyadic blocks each retain a fixed positive contribution
resolvent_column.one_resolvent_boundary: The standard r=1 vacuum column is therefore divergent before any boundedness or invertibility question for a Gross/IBC-style transform arises
resolvent_column.stable_remainder: Adding a norm-convergent remainder cannot cancel a fixed nonzero multiple of an unbounded column when r<=5/2
resolvent_column.ceiling: For r>5/2 only the vacuum column exists. No bounded or invertible dressing, full Wick interaction, self-adjoint resolvent limit, or source operator follows
